manufacturers.name: Tritik
manufacturers.notes: Independent audio-plugin developer (Krush/Krush2/KrushPro, Moodal, TkDelay, Irid, Visu, Tymee, Flaw, Echorus). Updates are direct downloads from tritik.com (per official FAQ). Legacy Krush still downloadable, unmaintained; Krush2 is a separate install (successor link recommended).

manufacturers.name: Sixth Sample
manufacturers.notes: Indie developer of free/commercial creative effects (Deelay, Cramit). Free plugins download directly; commercial via on-site cart. Several plugins co-developed with Integraudio; Sixth Sample is manufacturer of record.

plugins.name: Krush
plugins.notes: Original legacy bitcrusher; still downloadable but no longer maintained. Separate install from Krush2.

plugins.name: Krush2
plugins.notes: Rebuilt successor to Krush; installs separately.

plugins.name: Visu
plugins.notes: Bare-word name; matcher may need word-boundary handling.

plugins.name: Tymee
plugins.notes: Free product, sold separately from the Complete Bundle.

plugins.name: Flaw
plugins.notes: Bare-word name; matcher may need word-boundary handling. No public current version found.

plugins.name: Utopia
plugins.notes: Mastering plugin released 2026-06-24. No public version number observed.

plugins.name: Aurbit
plugins.notes: Collection of 12 hardware-inspired modulation effects. Formats not explicitly observed.

plugins.name: Further
plugins.notes: Reverb/spatial effect. Bare-word name; matcher may need word-boundary handling.

plugins.name: F(l)atter
plugins.notes: Dynamic multiband distortion. Official spelling F(l)atter. Formats not explicitly observed.

plugins.name: NASE
plugins.notes: Noise-Assisted Stereo Enhancer. Formats not explicitly observed.

plugins.name: Cramit PE
plugins.notes: Platinum Edition of Cramit (linear-phase OTT compressor). Separate paid product from free Cramit.

plugins.name: Deelay PE
plugins.notes: Platinum Edition of Deelay. Separate paid product from free Deelay.

plugins.name: Clips
plugins.notes: All-in-one clipper/compressor/gate dynamics plugin (with Integraudio). Formats not explicitly observed.

plugins.name: Spoton
plugins.notes: Free automatic pitch-correction plugin (Win/Mac). Official spelling Spoton. Formats not explicitly observed.

plugins.name: Cramit
plugins.notes: Free OTT-style multiband compressor with distortion (with Integraudio). Distinct from Cramit PE.

plugins.name: Deelay
plugins.notes: Free delay/multi-effect (with Integraudio). Distinct from Deelay PE.
